title: The integral Cech chain complex of a covering family in a category is exact in positive degrees
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The statement is a vanishing result for presheaves on an arbitrary category: for a family of morphisms U_i to U whose fibre products exist, the chain complex Z_{U,bullet} of abelian presheaves built in the printed context lemma has zero homology presheaves in positive degrees (statement lines 1026-1033). What has to be produced is not a citation but a chain of rewritings ending in an explicit homotopy: the proof evaluates at an object V, rewrites the terms as free abelian groups on the morphism sets Mor_C(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}), indexes everything by the morphism phi : V to U that is being lifted, uses the identification of morphisms into a fibre product with products of morphisms and the identity Z[A] direct sum Z[B] = Z[A coproduct B] to collapse each phi-summand to a complex on one set S_phi, and then finishes the reduced statement by the contracting homotopy n_{(s_0, ..., s_p)} to n_{(s, s_0, ..., s_p)} (proof lines 1037-1146). Neither the collapsing of the multi-indexed sum nor the homotopy is a formal consequence of the definitions; the case of an empty index set or of a set S with one element has to be seen to fit the same argument.
